=== Extract profile install list (module:module pairs) ===
profile install list count: 165
=== live enabled modules ===
live enabled count: 172

observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== Extract profile install list (module:module pairs) ==="; sed -n '/^install:/,/^[a-z_]*:/p' profile/openculturas.info.yml | grep -oE "^  - '[a-z0-9_]+:[a-z0-9_]+'" | sed "s/ - '//;s/'//g" | sort -u > /tmp/prof_install.txt
# handle lines without colon (bare 'module')
sed -n '/^install:/,/^[a-z_]*:/p' profile/openculturas.info.yml | grep -E "^  - '[a-z0-9_]+'$" | sed "s/ - '//;s/'//g" | sort -u >> /tmp/prof_install.txt
sort -u /tmp/prof_install.txt -o /tmp/prof_install.txt
echo "profile install list count: $(wc -l < /tmp/prof_install.txt)"
echo "=== live enabled modules ==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev drush cget core.extension module 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "^\s+[a-z0-9_]+:" | tr -d ' :' | sort -u > /tmp/live_mod.txt
echo "live enabled count: $(wc -l < /tmp/live_mod.txt)"
